headline: Executive order sets federal policy for a national system to alert and warn the public during emergencies.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government warns the American people about emergencies, such as disasters or attacks. It sets policy for a public alert and warning system and assigns federal agencies to carry it out. No official summary was provided, so details about specific duties, deadlines, or funding are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: People may receive emergency alerts and warnings through the system the order addresses.
Agencies are directed to plan, build, or run parts of the national alert and warning system.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 26, 2006; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
